nodes.text: Determine whether there exists a constant $C>1$ such that the following holds. Let $P$ be a finite projective plane . Must there exist a set of points $S$ such that $1\leq \lvert S\cap \ell\rvert \leq C$ for all lines $\ell$?

#1159 : [Va99,4.70] combinatorics A set which meets all lines at once is called a blocking set. In [Er81] Erdős asks the stronger question of whether this is true for all pairwise balanced block designs. Erdős, Silverman, and Stein [ESS83] proved this is true with $\lvert S\cap\ell \rvert\ll \log n$ for all lines $\ell$ (where $n$ is the order of the projective plane). See also [664] for a stronger question. This problem is mentioned after Problem 68 on Green's open problems list .
